releaseNotes: Hardening sweep: makes crash restart use a real safe startActivity fallback instead of retrying the same AlarmManager path, removes hardcoded release-signing secrets from source in favour of ignored local/env signing config, adds a provider-aware empty DNS feed so global portal override stays disabled and verifiable, and removes a stale tracked v4.24 APK. Yes, housekeeping. Boring is what stable looks like.
